name: Avatar
description: SEED contract for the FLUENT 2 round — props/axes only; anatomy is promoted from captured DOM truth. Subject: @fluentui/react-components@9.74.5 (Griffel CSS-in-JS; 65-package family pinned by the committed lockfile sha256 c3b230dfbd8abd68408fefed9c8abc0e0fd46722faf8652e16e5c038452e0536 — examples/fluent/RECON.md §1). EVERY enum default below is HAND-TRANSCRIBED from the package rollup's own @default/@defaultvalue JSDoc tag: the react-tsx extractor keeps the description prose but emits no `default` field (RECON §3a), so left to the drafter two of twelve components would have captured their whole grid around a base combo the library never renders. @default tags: shape=circular, active=unset, activeAppearance=ring (pinned, not an axis), size=32. THE DRAFTER PINNED active=active (first enum value) — the documented default is unset; this is the second of the two measured wrong-base-combo cases of RECON §3a. The `image` slot is refused by name (needs a remote src in a network-free harness); initials are deterministic from name="Fluent Two".

props.name: active
props.description: Fluent spells the third value of `active` as the STRING "unset" (@default unset). enumeration.unsetLabel is also "unset", and propSpaceFor refuses an axis whose enum already carries the unset label BY NAME. The contract value is therefore spelled "none" and mapped back to the library's "unset" through axisValueMap — the library value mounted is unchanged.

props.name: size
props.description: DEFAULTLESS BY DESIGN. `size` is a 14-member NUMERIC union (16…128) the extractor cannot carry; RECON §4.2 approves a named 3-of-13 subset {24,48,96}. Fluent's documented default is 32, which is NOT in that subset, so declaring any subset member as the default would assert a default the library does not have. Left defaultless, the engine prepends its `unset` pseudo-plane, which mounts the prop ABSENT — i.e. the base combo renders the library's REAL default (32). The named subset is unchanged; the base combo is the true default.
